title: trade.v1
description: One execution on the Kafka topic 'trades' (key = symbol), produced by the engine. Unique key: (engine_run_id, match_id).

engine_run_id.description: Random 64-bit id chosen at engine startup, as 16 lowercase hex chars. Distinguishes runs because match_id restarts at 1 (ADR 0005).

match_id.description: Engine match id, increasing within one run.

symbol.description: 1-8 chars (engine Symbol is char[8]); must exist in config/symbols.yaml.

aggressor_side.description: Side of the incoming order that crossed the spread (ADR 0006).

sequence_number.description: Engine event sequence, increasing within one run.

event_time_ns.description: Set by the engine: UTC ns since the Unix epoch, from 2001-09-09 (1e18). A monotonic-clock value (small number) is rejected. Exceeds 2^53: JavaScript consumers must use BigInt or string.

safe_positive_int.description: Positive and at most 2^53 - 1, so double-based JSON parsers read it exactly.
